_: Film d'accueil 45 s « bande-annonce » (19/10/2026). Texte validé par Kévin le 19/10 à 14 h 23 : « pourquoi nous et pas un autre terminal » (on trie, on publie nos résultats même quand on a tort, le niveau pro sans le prix pro). Le casting (branche bande-casting) a été lu avec la première version du texte.

lines.text: Tokyo opens. London takes over. New York shakes the world.
Every day, thousands of numbers. Other terminals give you all of them.
MACROARSENAL tells you which ones matter. Live.
lines.tts: Macro Arsenal tells you which ones matter. Live.

lines.text: Every morning, our read on the markets. Every evening, the verdict, published. Even when we're wrong.
And before every trade, Doji checks everything. Your plan. The levels. The calendar. Your risk.
The power of a pro terminal. Without the price of a pro terminal.
MACROARSENAL. The terminal that changes the way you see trading.
lines.tts: Macro Arsenal. The terminal that changes the way you see trading.

voices.label: EN, grave de cinéma (américain)
voices.design: A deep, powerful American male movie trailer narrator in his fifties: a very low, resonant bass voice with a touch of gravel and immense authority, the classic voice of Hollywood blockbuster trailers. Native General American accent. Close-microphone professional voice-over studio sound, rich low end, natural breathing, human and alive, never robotic.

voices.label: EN, puissant et moderne (britannique)
voices.design: A commanding British male voice-over artist in his late thirties, the voice of premium technology launches and luxury car commercials: deep, intense, controlled and refined, with quiet power. Native received pronunciation, London. Close-microphone professional voice-over studio sound, rich low end, natural breathing, human and alive, never robotic.

voices.label: EN, rauque et intense (américain)
voices.design: An American male voice-over artist in his forties with a dark, husky, gritty deep voice, intense and magnetic, like the narrator of a high-stakes thriller trailer. Native General American accent. Close-microphone professional voice-over studio sound, rich low end, natural breathing, human and alive, never robotic.

acting: Read it like an epic, cinematic movie trailer voice-over for a world-class product: slow, deep and powerful, with long dramatic pauses between sentences. Short sentences land like hammer blows. Low, resonant chest voice, quiet intensity that builds steadily towards the end; the final line is grand, confident and unforgettable. Never shouting, never rushed, every word crystal clear.
